bull.probability_evidence: The 2s10s curve has steepened to +0.51pp from ~+0.35pp 3m ago (macro overlay, computed from FRED DGS10/DGS2), a NIM tailwind if clean, and CEO Mike Lyons' $5.5bn non-core near-prime auto-loan exit is executing with guidance reaffirmed (Reuters 2026-09-15; Barclays conference transcript); if ROE closes the gap to peers, P/B could re-rate toward the 1.4x peer median from 0.9x, but the probability is trimmed below base/bear because the overlay's own net tilt is small-toward-bear.

target_band.cite: Fact sheet fair-value table bull row: P/B+ROE (best method) 43.92 vs DDM (second method) 34.12 (research/TFC/factsheet-2026-10-09.md Fair value table); FCFE DCF (78.40) excluded as a valuation anchor here because the evaluation's bear-case commentary establishes that method 'is not meaningful for a bank's cash flows' (research/TFC/2026-10-09-evaluation.md Bear case), a structural issue with applying FCFE DCF to a bank, not specific to the bear sign. Half the 9.80 spread (4.90) relative to the 55.42 bull target = 8.84%.

base.probability_evidence: TTM ROE (9.1%) is already close to its normalized run-rate and the last close (46.18) sits only 1.9% below the base blended fair value (47.05) (fact sheet Fair value table), so a continuation of the current trajectory into the Oct 16 results, consistent with management's reaffirmed 'modest NIM improvement' guidance, is the single most likely outcome and is given the largest weight.

target_band.cite: Fact sheet fair-value table base row: P/B+ROE (best method) 42.08 vs DDM (second method) 29.17 (research/TFC/factsheet-2026-10-09.md Fair value table); FCFE DCF (56.98) excluded as a valuation anchor for the same structural reason cited in the bull target_band (bank FCFE DCF reliability, research/TFC/2026-10-09-evaluation.md Bear case). Half the 12.91 spread (6.455) relative to the 47.05 base target = 13.72%.

bear.probability_evidence: TTM ROE (9.1%) sits below FY2021's 9.2% after negative ROE in FY2023/FY2024, and the 0.9x P/B discount to the 1.4x peer median simply matches that ROE gap rather than signalling mispricing (fact sheet Quality/Valuation); the macro overlay's real yields (+0.61pp/3m) and HY credit spreads (+0.39pp/3m) are a named, specific headwind to the reaffirmed 'modest NIM improvement' guidance ahead of the Oct 16 earnings catalyst, and the stock has no catalyst until then while trailing SPY by 20.8pp over 6 months (fact sheet Price section).

target_band.cite: Fact sheet fair-value table bear row: P/B+ROE (best method, and the evaluator's chosen bear target) 37.69 vs DDM (second method) 25.41 (research/TFC/factsheet-2026-10-09.md Fair value table); FCFE DCF (-9.55) excluded per the evaluation's own statement that it 'is not meaningful for a bank's cash flows' (research/TFC/2026-10-09-evaluation.md Bear case basis). Half the 12.28 spread (6.14) relative to the 37.69 bear target = 16.29%.

annual_probability.cite: Of 19 quarterly earnings-release weeks in the 5y history (research/TFC/2026-10-09-mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks, Q4 2021 through Q2 2026), only 1 (Q4 2021 results, week 2022-01-18, -8.81%) reached the magnitude of the chosen downside impact: 1/19=5.26% per quarter -> 1-(0.9474)^4=0.195, rounded to 0.20 annual probability of at least one such reaction.
